The stock analysis is based on the following five technical analysis methods: Moving Averages, MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence), Fibonacci Retracement, Bollinger Bands & Relative Strength Index (RSI).

The Moving Averages method assesses the trend of a stock's price by smoothing out price data over a specified period of time, which is usually done by calculating the Simple Moving Average (SMA) or the Exponential Moving Average (EMA). In this case, our analysis found that the stock has a Moving Averages score of 5 out of 10, suggesting a neutral trend.

The MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) method is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of a stock's price. Our analysis found a MACD score of 8 out of 10, indicating a positive trend for the stock.

The Fibonacci Retracement method is a technical analysis technique that identifies potential support and resistance levels based on Fibonacci ratios. Our analysis of the stock using Fibonacci Retracement has resulted in a score of 7 out of 10, further solidifying the positive outlook.

Bollinger Bands are used in technical analysis to determine whether a stock is overbought or oversold. It measures the volatility of a security and helps traders identify potential trading opportunities. Our analysis using the Bollinger Bands method resulted in a score of 6 out of 10, indicating that the stock is neither overbought nor oversold.

Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a technical indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate whether a stock is overbought or oversold, and is used to identify potential trading opportunities. Our analysis of the stock using the RSI method resulted in a score of 5 out of 10, suggesting that the stock is neither overbought nor oversold.

Based on the overall analysis, the stock has a positive trend and is neither overbought nor oversold. However, it is important to note that technical analysis is not a perfect science and should be used in conjunction with other factors when making investment decisions.
